cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5)
project(fastNoiseSIMD)

file(GLOB_RECURSE MY_RESOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/FastNoiseSIMD/*.cpp")
add_library(fastNoiseSIMD)

target_sources(fastNoiseSIMD PRIVATE ${MY_RESOURCES})
target_include_directories(fastNoiseSIMD PUBLIC "FastNoiseSIMD")
